description.value: You've read enough ash-storms and radiation weather to know when to dig in. You can predict hazardous weather (ashfall, radiation storms, acid rain) up to 24 hours in advance with a successful Nature check, as though Predicting Weather in a region with ordinary climate.

cinderfall.incomplete: Same problem as Read the Fallout Wind: this targets the Predict Weather activity, which ships with no rule-element representation in real pf2e and sets no discoverable roll option to predicate on.
